The standard published bound for oriented chains n≥15, plus a quantifier-free betweenness reduct and transitivity, supplies the infinite tail. No finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: Betweenness is the canonical order-reversal-invariant ternary relation on finite chains and models geodesic between on paths. Its exact finite-model-theoretic rank-four cutoff is a natural sharp invariant: orientation-sensitive chains need 15 points, whereas orientation-free betweenness stabilizes already at 14. The complete fourteen-class census and sharp representative bound offer a precise structural contrast rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
